title: Staircase Energy
description: Each staircase step has an energy cost. Starting before step 0, you may climb either one or two steps at a time. Find the minimum energy required to reach the top beyond the last step.
inputFormat: First line: n. Second line: n non-negative step costs.
outputFormat: Print the minimum total energy required to reach the top.
hints: The cheapest way to reach a step depends on the cheapest ways to reach the previous one or two steps.

examples.explanation: An optimal route pays 10 + 15 + 5 to reach the top.
The route can skip expensive step 1 and use the cheaper steps.
